description: Full lifecycle integration test using the fake GitHub server and MockRunner. Scenario: seed a trigger comment, start the daemon, verify it detects the comment, posts a status comment, runs the mock agent, and updates the status comment to completed. Flow under test: poll → claim → hydrate → run → report. Additional scenarios: duplicate webhook (same comment seen twice), duplicate claim race, restart recovery (seed a stale running comment with the machine UUID, verify it gets marked interrupted on startup), non-fast-forward push failure.
title: End-to-end task flow test (poll → claim → hydrate → classify → run → report)
